cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a GIS Analyst to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Support efforts in the coordination, management, and execution of the development, maintenance, implementation, training, and support of GIS & FME and related systems.
Support efforts in coordinating and planning the implementation, maintenance, and upgrades of hardware and software to support an Enterprise GIS throughout the Agency.
Support efforts in establishing and ensuring compliance of policies and procedures concerning the development and use of spatial data throughout the agency.
Responsible for map/data maintenance and development to include base maps, service area maps/data, and other maps/data as necessary through a cooperative effort with various departments throughout the agency.
Responsible for internal & external customer support and training on GIS & FME related applications and tools.
Provide technical support on projects. Successfully support tasks or projects as assigned. Provide support working with technology vendors and implementation partners to implement technical solutions.
Develop and ensure updates to technical and/or user documentation. Train users on GIS & FME systems and processes. Provide support in efforts to encourage system use and adoption with the business areas.
Support efforts in proactively configuring and managing systems in excellent working condition through implementation and monitoring of alerts, regular maintenance activities, performance tuning, software updates and patches. Provide support in working with internal IT teams and technology vendors to ensure GIS & FME systems are available and secure on a 24 by 7 basis.
Support efforts in system security by ensuring compliance with security standards and policies, monitoring access privileges, conducting risk assessments, investigation of suspicious activities, and remediation of identified security threats or risks.
Support efforts in the planning and undertaking of periodic risk analysis of systems and mitigate risks wherever possible. Provide support in the planning and testing of disaster recovery. Provide support in to implement, monitor, and verify backups. Provide support in resolving issues.
Follow change management and change control processes to plan and deploy system changes. Perform change-impact analysis. Communicate changes to business areas and IT.
Support efforts in researching, developing, and implementing IT standards and best practice policies and procedures.
Be responsible in always maintaining a safe working environment.
Perform other duties as required and/or assigned in support of the [Company name masked] Strategic Goals and the IT Vision, Mission, and Objectives aligned to these goals.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BA/BS in Geography, GIS, or related field. Additional related experience may substitute for degree on a year for year basis up to four years.
Two (2) years hands-on experience with Esri's ArcGIS suite of software, including ArcGIS Desktop, ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Mobile Apps.
Experience with ArcSDE/Enterprise Geodatabases on SQL Server.
Experience with direct end-user support in a customer service role. Demonstrated dedication to customer service.
Excellent organization abilities, analytical skills and communication skills including the ability to effectively communicate technical information to a non-technical audience.
Ability to work in a team environment in a matrix organization, partnering well with employees, management, users, business areas, vendors, contractors and undertake duties and tasks as assigned without close supervision.
Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities and diverse groups of people and activities simultaneously.
Proficiency using Microsoft Office Suite.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with Safe's Feature Manipulation Engine (FME) Desktop and Server.
Knowledge of General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS).
Developer skills including Python, HTML, JavaScript, SQL, and ArcGIS Arcade.
Be self-motivated and seek opportunities for continuous improvement of IT skills and processes. Be a catalyst and a willing participant of organizational changes.
Ability to be a positive and constructive contributor in a team-based environment.
Knowledge of Information System Implementation Lifecycle.

Experience with direct end-user support in a customer service role. Demonstrated dedication to customer service.
Excellent organization abilities, analytical skills and communication skills including the ability to effectively communicate technical information to a non-technical audience.

Establish and ensure compliance of policies and procedures concerning the development and use of spatial data throughout the agency.

Research, develop, and implement IT standards and best practice policies and procedures.
Maintain a safe working environment at all times.

BA/BS in Geography, GIS, or related field. Additional related experience may substitute for degree on a year for year basis up to four years.

Experience with an ArcSDE/Enterprise Geodatabases on SQL Server.

Excellent organization abilities, analytical skills and communication skills including the ability to effectively communicate technical information to a non-technical audience.

cond_0241.intro: The GIS Analyst (Application Systems Analyst, Geospatial) reports to the Technology Systems Program Manager or the Geospatial Program Manager. This position supports the planning, development, maintenance, and implementation of an Enterprise Geographic Information Systems (GIS).
cond_0241.responsibilities:
Support the coordination, management, and execution of development, maintenance, implementation, training, and support of GIS & FME and related systems.
Support the planning and implementation of hardware and software upgrades to maintain an Enterprise GIS across the agency.
Support the establishment and compliance of policies and procedures for the development and use of spatial data across the agency.
Handle map and data maintenance and development, including base maps, service area maps and data, and other maps as needed, working with various departments as required.
Provide internal and external customer support and training on GIS & FME applications and tools.
Provide technical support on assigned projects. Coordinate with technology vendors and implementation partners to deliver technical solutions.
Maintain and update technical and user documentation. Train users on GIS & FME systems and processes. Support system adoption within business areas.
Configure and manage systems to keep them in working condition through alerts, maintenance activities, performance tuning, and software updates. Coordinate with internal IT teams and technology vendors to ensure GIS & FME systems remain available and secure.
Support system security by ensuring compliance with security standards, monitoring access privileges, conducting risk assessments, investigating suspicious activities, and remediating identified threats.
Support periodic risk analysis and mitigation. Assist with disaster recovery planning and testing. Support backup implementation, monitoring, and verification. Help resolve issues as they arise.
Follow change management and change control processes to plan and deploy system changes. Perform change-impact analysis. Communicate changes to business areas and IT.
Support the research, development, and implementation of IT standards and best practice policies and procedures.
Maintain a safe working environment at all times.
Perform other duties as assigned in support of [Company name masked] strategic goals and the IT Vision, Mission, and Objectives.
